Urdu Text to PNG

Type Urdu text and download it as a crisp transparent PNG image in beautiful Noto Nastaliq Urdu — with adjustable size, colors and padding.

64px
48px

Type Urdu text above and watch the preview render in Noto Nastaliq Urdu. The checkerboard behind the preview means transparency — choose a solid background if you want one. Download gives you a crisp 2× PNG.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your Urdu text in the text box.
  2. Adjust the font size, text color, background and padding.
  3. Preview the rendered Nastaliq text live below the controls.
  4. Click Download PNG to save your image as urdu-text.png.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I get the text with a transparent background?

Yes. The transparent option gives you a PNG with no background, so you can place the Urdu text over photos, thumbnails or videos in any editor.

Is the rendered font free for commercial use?

Yes — Noto Nastaliq Urdu is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which permits free personal and commercial use.

Will the PNG look sharp when I enlarge it?

The image is exported at 2× supersampling, so edges stay sharp even when enlarged. For very long text the lines wrap automatically at a comfortable width.
